Description: Control Kitten Space Agency with your Stream Deck (requires the kRPC mod for KSA).
Name: KSA Flight Deck

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.status.Name: kRPC Status
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.status.Tooltip: Shows the link to the kRPC server and the vehicle under control

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.readout.Name: Telemetry Readout
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.readout.Tooltip: Show a live readout such as altitude, apoapsis or propellant

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.sequence.Name: Next Sequence
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.sequence.Tooltip: Activate the next sequence and show which one is active

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.engine.Name: Engine
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.engine.Tooltip: Switch the engines on or off and show their state

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.autopilot.Name: Auto-Pilot Mode
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.autopilot.Tooltip: Engage the auto-pilot in a chosen mode; press again to let go

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.toggle.Name: Control Toggle
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.toggle.Tooltip: Toggle RCS, lights, stabilization or pulsed thrust

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.throttle.Name: Throttle
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.throttle.Tooltip: Turn the throttle up or down

com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.warp.Name: Time Warp
com.novistrum.ksaflightdeck.warp.Tooltip: Step the simulation speed up or down, and pause
